hero.headline: Hi, I'm Het.
hero.headlineSoft: I help plants keep their vacuum running.
hero.lede: I work in industrial vacuum — visiting plants, understanding the process, and matching the right pump, spare or service to it. Based in Vadodara, Gujarat.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a mechanical engineer turned technical salesperson. Most of my week is spent on plant floors with maintenance and production teams, working out why a vacuum line isn't pulling down, why a pump keeps losing oil, or which pump suits a new process.

I like to start with the process, not the catalogue: vacuum level, capacity, what gas and vapour the pump is handling, temperature, corrosiveness and running hours. Getting that right first is what makes the recommendation stick.
Outside the plant, I'm the person customers call for a quick answer on a part number, an overhaul plan or a replacement for an old pump.

points: Plant visits & surveys — finding and studying vacuum applications across process plants.
Pump selection — recommending new pumps or direct equivalents for installed ones.
Spares, service & AMC — multi-brand spares, repair coordination and annual maintenance contracts.
Offers & follow-up — technical and commercial quotations through to order.
New business — opening new plants, industries and EPC accounts.

applications.title: Where vacuum does the work.
applications.lede: Every process asks something different of a vacuum pump: a deeper vacuum, more vapour, more hours, harsher gases. Here are the applications I see most on plant visits. For each one: the vacuum range, the pumps usually installed, what goes wrong, and the spares that fix it.
applications.heroAlt: Mechvac vacuum pumps and skid-mounted vacuum systems: rotary vane pumps, a Roots booster and two process vacuum skids with condensers
applications.listIntro: Filter by industry, then open any application for the details.
applications.approachTitle: How I look at an application
applications.approachIntro: Horsepower and price come last. The process comes first.

steps.title: Walk the process
steps.text: What's in the vessel, what leaves it as vapour, how hot, how long the cycle runs.

steps.title: Measure the duty
steps.text: Working vacuum, pumping speed, gas and condensable load, corrosiveness, running hours.

steps.title: Match the pump
steps.text: Oil-sealed, dry, booster-assisted: and the condenser, trap or filter that protects it.

steps.title: Keep it running
steps.text: Right spares in stock, planned overhauls, and an AMC if the pump is critical.
